summary: Radiopharm Theranostics Ltd furnished a Form 6-K attaching an ASX public notice titled 'Change of Director's Interest Notices x 4,' equivalent to a US Form 4 insider ownership filing. The disclosed notice covers director Bruce Goodwin, who acquired 2,777,778 fully paid ordinary shares at A$0.009 per share (A$25,000) plus 2,777,778 listed options exercisable at A$0.018 expiring 31 July 2029, via participation in a Securities Purchase Plan following shareholder approval at the 11 September 2026 EGM. Holdings moved from nil to 2,777,778 shares and options. This is routine insider-interest disclosure, not a special situation; no deal terms apply.
